title: Formal specification and behavioral simulation of the holiday gift exchange game
summary: The holiday gift exchange game is a familiar social institution with nontrivial strategic structure. We provide a formal treatment of the game's mechanics, defining the state space, action sets, and the recursive structure of stealing chains; we prove termination and derive an algorithm for counting distinct game trajectories, which grow far faster than the space of possible final allocations.
